name: DFS Cycle Detection
summary: Depth-first search the prerequisite graph, colouring each course white (unseen), grey (on the current path), or black (finished). If a grey course is reached again, a cycle exists and the courses cannot be finished.
visualizationIntent: init: build the prerequisite graph. loop: run DFS from each unfinished course using an explicit stack; the current node is highlighted and grey nodes are on the active path. check: if an edge leads to a grey node, that is a back-edge and a cycle — grey nodes flash red. update: when a node's neighbours are done it turns black. return: true only if no cycle was found.

lineExplanations.13: Add an edge from prerequisite to dependent.
lineExplanations.14: Record the dependent as a neighbour.
lineExplanations.20: Start scanning courses for a DFS root.
lineExplanations.22: Start a DFS only from an unvisited (white) course.
lineExplanations.23: Seed the DFS stack with this course.
lineExplanations.24: Run DFS while the stack has nodes.
lineExplanations.25: Peek at the node on top of the stack.
lineExplanations.26: Mark it as the current node.
lineExplanations.28: Colour it grey — it is on the current path.
lineExplanations.31: A grey neighbour is a back-edge — a cycle.
lineExplanations.34: Add the neighbour to the DFS stack.
lineExplanations.36: Second visit: all neighbours done, colour it black.
lineExplanations.38: Clear the current node between components.
lineExplanations.40: The courses can be finished only if no cycle was found.
lineExplanations.41: Return whether all courses can be finished.

syntaxExplanations.1: class Solution: defines the class wrapper expected by the platform.
syntaxExplanations.2: def canFinish(self, numCourses, prerequisites): receives the course count and prerequisite pairs.
syntaxExplanations.3: nodes = [] will hold one graph node per course.
syntaxExplanations.4: for i in range(numCourses): iterates the courses.
syntaxExplanations.6: edges = [] will hold the directed edges.
syntaxExplanations.7: adj = [] will hold each course's neighbours.
syntaxExplanations.8: for i in range(numCourses): iterates the courses.
syntaxExplanations.9: adj.append([]) starts an empty neighbour list.
syntaxExplanations.10: for p in range(len(prerequisites)): iterates prerequisite pairs.
syntaxExplanations.11: a = prerequisites[p][0] is the dependent course.
syntaxExplanations.12: b = prerequisites[p][1] is the prerequisite course.
syntaxExplanations.13: edges.append({"from": b, "to": a}) draws the edge b to a.
syntaxExplanations.14: adj[b].append(a) records a as a neighbour of b.
syntaxExplanations.15: color = [] will hold each course's colour.
syntaxExplanations.16: for i in range(numCourses): iterates the courses.
syntaxExplanations.18: has_cycle = False assumes no cycle until found.
syntaxExplanations.20: start = 0 begins scanning for DFS roots.
syntaxExplanations.21: while start < numCourses: scans every course.
syntaxExplanations.22: if color[start] == 0: starts DFS only from white courses.
syntaxExplanations.23: stack = [start] seeds the explicit DFS stack.
syntaxExplanations.24: while len(stack) > 0: runs DFS until the stack empties.
syntaxExplanations.25: node_id = stack[len(stack) - 1] peeks the top node.
syntaxExplanations.27: if color[node_id] == 0: is the node's first visit.
syntaxExplanations.28: color[node_id] = 1 colours it grey (on the path).
syntaxExplanations.29: for k in range(len(adj[node_id])): iterates its neighbours.
syntaxExplanations.30: nb = adj[node_id][k] is a neighbour course.
syntaxExplanations.31: if color[nb] == 1: a grey neighbour is a back-edge.
syntaxExplanations.33: if color[nb] == 0: a white neighbour is unexplored.
syntaxExplanations.34: stack.append(nb) pushes it to explore next.
syntaxExplanations.36: color[node_id] = 2 colours a finished node black.
syntaxExplanations.38: cur = -1 clears the current node between components.
syntaxExplanations.39: start = start + 1 moves to the next course.
syntaxExplanations.40: result = not has_cycle is true only when no cycle exists.
syntaxExplanations.41: return result reports whether all courses can be finished.
